title: Nextpower Reports Q1 Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
summary: Record quarterly revenue and backlog driven by strong customer demand and disciplined execution; continued expansion of power technology platform Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power technology solutions, today announced financial results for the first quarter for fiscal year 2027, ended July 3, 2026.
